papers.title_en: Test-Time Scaling of Text-to-Image Flow Matching Models with Noise-Rejuvenated Sequential Monte Carlo
papers.authors: Wenyi Lian, Zheng Zhao, Thomas B. Sch{ö}n
papers.evidence: 流匹配生成模型的推理时扩展
papers.tldr: 扩散模型可用SMC进行测试时缩放，但标准SMC依赖随机提议，难以直接迁移到由确定性ODE主导的flow matching模型。本文提出noise-rejuvenated SMC：重采样后改变源噪声，并用当前端点估计构造新的中间状态，使粒子在flow matching插值形式内探索而无需转为SDE，另加look-ahead机制在加权前精炼粒子。在Stable Diffusion 3、FLUX.1-dev和Z-Image上，奖励引导生成一致提升，消融验证噪声复兴与look-ahead均有效。
papers.abstract_en: Test-time scaling of diffusion models with sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) has become a promising strategy for sampling under user-specified rewards, such as human preference scores. However, the standard SMC framework typically relies on stochastic proposals and therefore does not directly transfer to flow matching models, in which inference is governed by deterministic ODEs. In this work, we introduce noise-rejuvenated SMC, an inference-time scaling method tailored for text-to-image flow matching models. Our key idea is to perturb each resampled particle by changing its source noise and constructing a new intermediate state using its current endpoint estimate. This moves the particle to another state that remains representable under the flow-matching interpolation form, enabling particle exploration without converting the sampler to an SDE. We further introduce a look-ahead mechanism to refine resampled particles before weighting. Experiments on Stable Diffusion 3, FLUX.1-dev, and Z-Image demonstrate consistent improvements in reward-guided generation, while ablation studies validate the contributions of noise rejuvenation and look-ahead refinement. Code is available at https://github.com/shermanlian/NR-SMC.

papers.authors: Maojiang Su, Qijie Zhu, Yu Xiao, Shuyang Yu, Minshuo Chen, Zhaoran Wang, Han Liu
papers.evidence: 扩散与流模型作为生成式策略类
papers.tldr: 扩散与流策略表达力强，但其动作似然不可解，难以直接套用PPO、GRPO等策略优化。DoobPO利用Doob h-transform实现免似然的生成策略微调：先学习轻量比率模型表示策略改进，再通过条件漂移匹配把比率倾斜目标蒸馏回生成策略。方法统一适用于扩散与流策略，并在MuJoCo连续控制上优于扩散/流策略基线，为生成策略的RL微调提供有原则且实用的路径。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion and flow models provide expressive policy classes for robotic and sequential decision-making systems. However, their action likelihoods are generally intractable, limiting the direct use of widely adopted policy optimization methods such as PPO and GRPO. We propose Doob Policy Optimization (DoobPO), a framework that leverages Doob's $h$-transform for likelihood-free reinforcement learning fine-tuning of generative policies. DoobPO separates policy improvement from generative policy learning. It first learns a lightweight ratio model that represents the desired policy update, and then distills the resulting ratio-tilted target policy into the generative policy via conditional drift matching. This formulation applies uniformly to both diffusion and flow policies and supports a broad family of policy improvement rules, including PPO and GRPO. We prove that the practical conditional drift matching objective is gradient-equivalent to the ideal Doob drift matching objective. We further show that the induced diffusion process solves an endpoint-constrained stochastic optimal control problem. This establishes that it achieves the minimum-energy modification required to realize the desired policy tilt. Across MuJoCo continuous-control benchmarks, DoobPO achieves strong performance against competitive diffusion- and flow-policy baselines, showing a principled and practical route to RL fine-tuning for generative policies.

papers.title_en: PoSTCache: From Forecasting to Postdictive Smoothing for Revisable Diffusion Caching
papers.authors: Liwei Lan, Hui Chen, Jungong Han, Guiguang Ding
papers.evidence: 通过可修订缓存加速扩散与流匹配生成模型
papers.tldr: 扩散与流匹配模型生成质量高，但迭代采样计算昂贵；缓存加速无需训练，却多采用单向信息流，跳过步的近似一旦写入轨迹便无法利用后续反馈。PoSTCache 将缓存重构为可修正轨迹推断：先用现有策略生成前向提议，在后续完整计算步用刷新预测与提议的差异形成校正信号，并反向精修先前预测；同时提出 PVR 按轨迹不确定性下降选择锚点。图像与视频生成实验表明，它在代表性缓存方法上持续改善质量—效率权衡，提供免训练、即插即用的加速框架。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion and flow matching models achieve impressive visual generation quality but remain computationally expensive due to iterative sampling. Caching-based acceleration provides a practical training-free solution by reusing or predicting intermediate features. However, existing methods largely enforce a forward-only information flow: approximations produced for skipped model evaluations are immediately committed to the sampling trajectory and cannot benefit from feedback generated by later full-computation steps. We propose \textbf{PoSTCache} (\emph{Postdictive Smoothing Trajectory Cache}), a training-free and plug-and-play framework that reformulates diffusion caching as revisable trajectory inference. PoSTCache first uses an existing caching strategy to construct forward proposals for skipped steps. At a later full-computation step, the discrepancy between the refreshed prediction and its forward proposal yields a correction signal, which PoSTCache propagates backward to refine and reintegrate the preceding predictions. Viewing full-computation steps as sources of corrective feedback also changes how they should be selected. We therefore introduce the Posterior Variance Reduction (PVR) strategy, which estimates cross-timestep dependencies from offline denoising trajectories and selects anchors according to their expected reduction in surrogate trajectory uncertainty rather than local approximation error alone. Experiments on representative image and video generation models show that PoSTCache consistently improves the quality--efficiency trade-off over representative caching methods.

papers.title_en: LEAP: Accelerating ODE-based Diffusion Sampling with Optimal Linear Leaps
papers.authors: Haowei Zheng, Zhenyu Zhou, Jiawei Chen, Can Wang, Defang Chen
papers.evidence: 基于ODE求解的扩散模型加速采样
papers.tldr: 扩散模型常借助通用ODE数值方法实现免训练加速采样，但时间离散较粗时性能明显下降。LEAP从采样轨迹的低维性与跨轨迹一致性出发，在局部轨迹子空间中建立监督最小二乘问题，无需模型评估即可精确逼近未来状态。实验在Stable Diffusion 3.5、FLUX.1-dev文生图及TRELLIS.2图生3D等任务上优于先前方法，并可即插即用地增强现有求解器。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models primarily rely on general-purpose ODE-based numerical methods for training-free accelerated sampling, but performance degrades with coarse time discretization. In this paper, we propose optimal linear leaps (LEAP), a specialized method grounded in theoretical and empirical investigations of sampling trajectory geometry. Built upon low-dimensionality and cross-trajectory consistency, LEAP formulates a supervised least-squares optimization problem within the local trajectory subspace, achieving a precise approximation of future states without model evaluations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LEAP outperforms previous methods across diverse modalities, including text-to-image (Stable Diffusion 3.5, FLUX.1-dev) and image-to-3D (TRELLIS.2) generation. Furthermore, LEAP can be seamlessly integrated into existing solver-based methods, offering a plug-and-play enhancement for modern diffusion models. Code is available at https://github.com/zju-pi/LEAP.

papers.title_en: PnP-CF: A Consensus Flow-Matching Solver for General Inverse Problems
papers.evidence: 以流匹配去噪器作为逆问题生成先验
papers.tldr: 基于连续时间生成先验的PnP方法能高质量求解逆问题，但求解器与生成采样器之间的共识机制决定效果。PnP-CF将流匹配去噪器与类ADMM对偶变量更新、时间自适应回拉结合，在流概率路径上融合随机与确定性分量以稳定算法。实验表明其在线性逆问题上至少媲美先进基线，并能处理含预训练神经网络前向算子的非线性逆问题。该工作把共识流框架扩展到更一般的逆问题，提升了适用性与鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods using continuous-time deep generative models as learned data distribution priors enable synthesizing high-quality solutions of model-based inverse problems. The quality of the solutions depends critically on the interplay and consensus between the inverse problem solver and the generative model sampler. We revisit a recently introduced flow-based PnP framework, which we refer to as PnP-CF (Consensus Flow), and extend its application to nonlinear inverse problems, including those with learned neural-network forward operators. PnP-CF combines a flow-matching denoiser with (i) ADMM-like dual variable updates and (ii) a time-adaptive pullback onto the intermediate flow probability path that combines a stochastic and a deterministic component. We discuss how these two features stabilize the algorithm and promote consensus, and demonstrate on a set of experiments that PnP-CF not only solves standard linear inverse problems with quality at least comparable to state-of-the-art baselines, but also extends gracefully to nonlinear inverse problems, including forward operators realized by pretrained neural networks, for which existing methods produce unsatisfactory results or fail completely.

papers.title_en: HP-PnP-Flow: Hybrid Time Scheduling and Projection for Plug-and-Play Image Restoration via Flow Matching
papers.authors: Yong Li, Xiaojie Wang, Xiaoyan Zhang
papers.evidence: 基于流匹配ODE动力学的即插即用图像复原
papers.tldr: 图像复原是典型逆问题，PnP框架能灵活集成预训练去噪器，flow matching则以连续时间ODE提供高效生成建模。现有PnP-Flow虽将二者结合，但其收敛分析对迭代施加较严格条件，限制了实际应用。本文提出HP-PnP-Flow，引入混合时间调度与像素空间投影算子，并在温和假设下建立严格收敛保证。实验显示，该方法在去噪、去模糊、超分辨率和随机/盒式修复等任务上显著优于PnP-Flow，且去模糊与超分辨率在AFHQ-Cat上迭代数可由500降至100。
papers.abstract_en: Image restoration is a fundamental inverse problem that seeks to recover high-quality images from degraded observations. Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods provide a flexible framework for integrating pretrained denoisers into iterative reconstruction, whereas flow matching offers an efficient generative modeling approach based on continuous-time ODE dynamics. Very recently, Martin et al.\ (ICLR, 2025) developed a PnP-Flow method, which integrates the PnP framework with flow matching through a time-dependent denoiser constructed from a pretrained flow matching model.By incorporating a different time schedule and an additional pixel-space projection operator, this paper proposes a novel efficient PnP-Flow algorithm (HP-PnP-Flow) that enjoys rigorous convergence guarantees under mild assumptions, without imposing restrictive conditions on iterates required by the aforementioned work. Numerical experiments on CelebA and AFHQ-Cat demonstrate that the newly proposed HP-PnP-Flow algorithm significantly outperforms PnP-Flow on several restoration tasks such as denoising, deblurring, super-resolution, random inpainting, and box inpainting. Notably, our algorithm achieves comparable or better reconstruction quality with substantially fewer iterations, reducing the iteration count from $500$ to $100$ for deblurring and super-resolution on AFHQ-Cat.

papers.title_en: Learning to Absorb Corrections: Critic-Weighted Residual Flow for Vision-Based Insertion
papers.authors: Yiqing Yuan, Zhi Li, Jinrong Yang, Mingshan Sun, Mei Yu Zhi, Yong Zhao, Liangliang Ren, Hui Cheng
papers.evidence: 条件残差流策略用流匹配生成机器人动作
papers.tldr: 视觉插入任务需在保留示教行为的同时纠正对齐误差。ACT-Flow 将自适应 ACT 与条件残差流策略耦合，先锚点引导预热，再通过行为克隆吸收成功动作，并重算残差目标。分块 critic 依据成功/失败交互评估组合动作，为残差候选加权并辅以成功执行监督。五任务平均成功率在 2 万步达 66%，较最强基线高 18 个百分点。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-based insertion requires correcting alignment errors while retaining useful behavior learned from demonstrations. We present ACT--Flow, an online learning framework that couples an adaptive Action Chunking Transformer (ACT) with a conditional residual flow policy. Following anchor-guided warmup, ACT absorbs successful executed actions through behavioral cloning, while residual targets are recomputed relative to the updated prior. A chunk-level critic learns from successful and failed interactions and evaluates final composed actions. Its estimates weight generated residual candidates for flow matching, complemented by supervision from successful real executions. Candidate scoring is confined to training; deployment uses RGB observations and samples one residual per action chunk. We evaluate the framework on power-plug, USB, and key insertion, together with cable routing and needle threading. Results show a five-task mean success rate of 66% at 20,000 post-initialization interaction steps, exceeding the strongest baseline by 18 percentage points at this checkpoint. Evaluations at matched checkpoints with the residual disabled show ACT's mean success increasing from 16% to 76%. Component ablations further support the complementary roles of behavior absorption, value weighting, and successful-action supervision.
